name: quarterplan-excel
description: Quarterly capacity and delivery planning for IT teams in Excel

scripts.build: node scripts/check_environment.mjs && node scripts/build_quarter_planning_step1.mjs && node scripts/create_quarter_planning_xlsm.mjs
scripts.normalize: node scripts/check_environment.mjs && node scripts/normalize_workbook_design.mjs outputs/quarter_planning_step1.xlsx outputs/quarter_planning_step2.xlsm
scripts.sanitize:assets: node scripts/check_environment.mjs && node scripts/sanitize_workbook_metadata.mjs "assets/Шаблон Экспресс оценки.xlsx"
scripts.verify: node scripts/check_environment.mjs && node scripts/build_quarter_planning_step1.mjs && node scripts/create_quarter_planning_xlsm.mjs && node scripts/generate_vba_limits.mjs --check && node --test tests/*.test.mjs && node scripts/verify_xlsx_fingerprint.mjs && node scripts/verify_static_contracts.mjs
scripts.verify:static: node scripts/check_environment.mjs && node scripts/generate_vba_limits.mjs --check && node --test tests/*.test.mjs && node scripts/verify_xlsx_fingerprint.mjs && node scripts/verify_static_contracts.mjs
scripts.verify:release: node scripts/check_environment.mjs && node scripts/build_release.mjs && node scripts/verify_public_release.mjs
scripts.poc:tstvba:verify: npm run poc:tstvba:lint && node --test poc/typescript-to-vba-poc.test.mjs && node scripts/verify_typescript_to_vba_poc.mjs
scripts.poc:tsvba:verify: npm run poc:tsvba:lint && node --test poc/restricted-ts-vba/test/*.test.mjs && node scripts/verify_restricted_ts_vba_poc.mjs
scripts.verify:excel: node scripts/run_windows_powershell.mjs verify_scheduler_com.ps1 && node scripts/run_windows_powershell.mjs verify_all.ps1 -SkipBuild
